summary.en: The RSF is under US pressure for a humanitarian truce as UN officials call for an immediate halt to drone strikes that are killing civilians across Sudan, including a market in Darfur where over 30 people died. The RSF also attacked a Red Crescent volunteer and a livestock market in Nyala, killing and injuring dozens of women and children, while the SAF blamed the RSF for a market bombing in Darfur. El Niño has contributed to a humanitarian crisis, killing hundreds of children. A Russian diplomat alleges that US weapons supplied to Ukraine have been found in RSF possession. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF er under amerikansk press for en humanitær våpenhvile mens FN-tjenestemenn krever et umiddelbart stopp på droneangrep som dreper sivile over hele Sudan, inkludert et marked i Darfur hvor over 30 personer døde. RSF angrep også en Røde Halvmåne-frivillig og et husdyrmarked i Nyala, og drepte og såret dusinvis av kvinner og barn, mens SAF beskyldte RSF for en markedsbombing i Darfur. El Niño har bidratt til en humanitær krise, og drept hundrevis av barn. En russisk diplomat hevder at amerikanske våpen levert til Ukraina er funnet i RSF-besittelse. 4 680 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
